title: Flaky: resources::tests::gateway_coordinator_post_slots_enforces_max_claim_duration passes solo, fails intermittently in full lichen-gateway lib suite
description: Observed on beads-worker-7 @ 6d0e4c78fc: test passes when run with a name filter (cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib slot) but FAILED in one full-suite run (9 FAILED lines incl. it, 263 passed) and PASSED in the next full-suite run (8 failed, it green). Order/timing/shared-state dependent — same flakiness class as up5p (oscore timing) and qfqk (coap timing pressure). Investigate shared slot-state persistence dir, unix_now() superframe-boundary sensitivity, or parallel-test contention in resources.rs tests.
